items.title: CONTINUATION OF REMOTE MEETINGS Discussion and possible action to adopt a resolution making findings pursuant to AB361 to allow for continued remote meetings due to the COVID-19 pandemic. (ACTION ITEM)
PRESIDENT’S REPORT (DISCUSSION ONLY) a) Openings and Events b) Commission Administrative Matters c) Acknowledgements

GENERAL MANAGER’S REPORT (DISCUSSION ONLY) a) Financial Matters b) Capital Report c) Property Management d) Recreation Programs e) Park, Recreation and Open Space Advisory Committee Report f) Events g) Legislation

GENERAL PUBLIC COMMENT - UP TO 15 MINUTES – THIS ITEM WILL BE CONTINUED TO ITEM 12 At this time, members of the public may address the Commission on items of interest to the public that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission and that do not appear on the agenda. With respect to agenda items, you will have opportunity to address the Commission when the item is reached in the meeting.
SAN FRANCISCO ZOO Presentation and discussion only to update the Commission on operational and management issues at the San Francisco Zoo. (DISCUSSION ONLY)

770 WOOLSEY STREET ACQUISITION – SET ASIDE Discussion and possible action to recommend that the Board of Supervisors authorize the Recreation and Park Department to set aside an amount of up to $3M from the Open Space Acquisition Fund for a potential future partnership with Friends of 770 Woolsey to remediate, develop and acquire a portion of the 770 Woolsey lot to create a future urban agriculture hub in the Portola neighborhood. (ACTION ITEM) This item was referred from the Capital Committee to the General Calendar with recommendation to approve. Staff: Yael Golan and Abigail Maher –

MARINA RULES AND REGULATIONS Discussion and possible action to amend the Marina Rules and Regulations to require payment of the full berthing fee during periods of temporary absences, with a credit back to the bertholder for days when the berth is re-rerented, subject to certain conditions. (ACTION ITEM) This item was referred from the Operations Committee to the General Calendar without recommendation. Staff: Scott Grindy –

GENE FRIEND RECREATION CENTER – CONTRACT AWARD Discussion and possible action to award a contract for Construction Manager / General Contractor (CM/GC) services for the Gene Friend Recreation Center Project (RFQP ID No. 0000006708) to Swinerton Builders in the amount of up to $38,999,208. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: Melinda Sullivan –
CLOSED SESSION – CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL

GENERAL PUBLIC COMMENT – CONTINUED FROM ITEM 5 IF NECESSARY At this time members of the public who were not able to address the Commission on Item 5 may address the Commission on items that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Recreation and Park Commission and that do not appear on the agenda.

COMMISSIONERS’ MATTERS This item is designed to allow Commissioners to raise issues they believe the Commission should address at future meetings. There will be no discussion of these items at this time.

COMMUNICATIONS (DISCUSSION ONLY) From Leon Sultan, Alice Brydges, Linda Shaffer, Barbara Sapienza, Kate Stenberg, Peter Sapienza and San Franciscan for Urban Nature regarding the Observation Wheel in Golden Gate Park. From Denise Louie regarding fire preparedness. From Steph, Elizabeth Kurhan and YIMBY Law regarding Potrero 1458 San Bruno Avenue and del Sol Park. From Nelson Gutierrez regarding Yik Oi Huang Peace and Friendship Park (Visitacion Valley Playground). From Karen Gascon regarding Lessing & Sears Mini Park. From Tonya Russi on behalf of the Regional Water Board regarding Parque Niños Unidos. From 57 individuals in support of car-free Great Highway.
